docs.title: beesum-min
docs.text:
Transcript-first YouTube summarizer for the terminal: yt-dlp + WebVTT + local or API LLMs.

dotnet tool install -g beesum-min
beesum-min "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..." --timestamps

transcript-only is the default. Ollama stays local; cloud providers are opt-in.

docs.title: Start
docs.text:
• Install
  • CLI
  • MCP
  • Library
  • Security

The local core is host-agnostic; a server layer is not part of this repository.

docs.title: CLI
docs.text:
# Transcript only
beesum-min "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..." 

# Local Ollama
beesum-min "..." --provider ollama --ollama-model qwen3:1.7b --format markdown

# JSON for scripts
beesum-min "..." --json

# Clip and save
beesum-min "..." --from 00:12:34 --to 00:18:00 --timestamps `
  --save-vtt clip.vtt --save-transcript clip.md -o notes.md

# stdin
Get-Content captions.vtt | beesum-min --stdin --input vtt --timestamps

# Batch
beesum-min --batch urls.txt --jsonl

docs.title: Flags
docs.text:
Flag Meaning --provider transcript-only, ollama, openai, anthropic, gemini --style historian, programmer, neutral --format markdown, plaintext, mindmap --prompt-file full system-prompt override --instructions append to the built-in prompt --timestamps [hh:mm:ss] cues and timestamp-aware prompts --from / --to clip transcript by time --save-vtt copy the full VTT --save-transcript write the clipped transcript/summary --json one stable object --jsonl one object per batch item --stdin read a transcript from stdin --batch one URL per line --no-chunk disable map-reduce chunking --proxy passed to yt-dlp

Progress goes to stderr; stdout is the result (or JSON).

docs.title: Doctor
docs.text:
beesum-min doctor
beesum-min doctor --json
beesum-min doctor --check-updates

Checks yt-dlp, deno, temp, Ollama, and the selected provider's key. Update checks are opt-in and never download anything.

docs.title: Embedding Beesum.Core
docs.text:
This guide shows how to use the Core library from your own application: register the services, run the pipeline, read the result metadata, plug in a custom LLM provider, and test everything without network access.

The package targets .NET 10 and follows 0.x versioning: the public API may still change between minor releases.

docs.title: 1. Install
docs.text:
dotnet add package Beesum.Core
dotnet add package Beesum.Testing   # in test projects

docs.title: 2. Register the services
docs.text:
using Beesum.Core.Abstractions;
using Beesum.Core.DependencyInjection;
using Beesum.Core.Models;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

var services = new ServiceCollection();

services.AddBeesum(options =>
{
    options.LlmProviderId = "transcript-only"; // or "ollama"
    options.OllamaBaseUrl = "http://localhost:11434"; // set to null to skip Ollama
    options.OllamaModel = "llama3.2";
});

await using var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
var pipeline = provider.GetRequiredService<ISummarizerPipeline>();

AddBeesum registers contracts and their default implementations and exposes the same values as IOptions<BeesumOptions>:

var options = provider.GetRequiredService<IOptions<BeesumOptions>>().Value;

The container structure (which providers exist, where yt-dlp comes from) is decided at registration time. Mutating the options object afterwards does not re-register services.

docs.title: Options
docs.text: Property Default Purpose YtDlpPath null Explicit yt-dlp path; null auto-detects settings → tools/ → PATH. OllamaBaseUrl http://localhost:11434 Ollama URL; null/empty disables the provider. OllamaModel llama3.2 Ollama model name. OpenAiBaseUrl null OpenAI-compatible URL; null/empty disables the provider. OpenAiModel gpt-4o-mini OpenAI-compatible model name. OpenAiApiKeyProvider null API-key callback; null reads openai.apiKey from ISecretStore. LlmProviderId transcript-only Provider used by the default pipeline. SubtitlesDirectory null Persistent subtitle directory; null uses a temp directory. StorageRoot platform default Root for settings, secrets, cache, and history. YtDlpExtraArgs empty Extra arguments for every yt-dlp call (--proxy, cookies, ...). SubtitleLanguages en yt-dlp --sub-langs selectors, in preference order. ChunkLongTranscripts true Split transcripts over ChunkTokens and combine partial summaries. ChunkTokens 6000 Approximate input budget per chunk.

docs.title: From a local subtitle file
docs.text:
var result = await pipeline.RunAsync(
    new SummarizeCommand(
        Url: string.Empty,
        PromptStyle.Neutral,
        OutputFormat.Markdown,
        LocalVttPath: "captions.vtt"),
    progress: null,
    cancellationToken: CancellationToken.None);

if (!result.IsSuccess)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine(result.ErrorMessage);
    return;
}

Console.WriteLine(result.Content);

docs.title: From a YouTube URL
docs.text:
var result = await pipeline.RunAsync(
    new SummarizeCommand(
        Url: "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...",
        PromptStyle.Historian,
        OutputFormat.Markdown),
    cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

The URL path needs yt-dlp to be installed (or pointed to by YtDlpPath). The library never starts a download on its own: a call to RunAsync is the user action.

docs.title: Progress
docs.text:
Stages are reported in order: Starting, Downloading, Parsing, Summarizing, Completed. Completed fires only on success.

var progress = new Progress<PipelineStage>(stage => Console.WriteLine(stage));
await pipeline.RunAsync(command, progress);

IProgress<T> callbacks may run on the captured synchronization context; pass a synchronous implementation in tests if order matters.

docs.title: 4. Read the result
docs.text:
SummaryResult is a record:

Member Meaning IsSuccess Whether a summary was produced. Content Summary text, or empty on failure. ProviderId Provider that produced the result; null if the pipeline failed early. ErrorMessage Human-readable failure reason on failure. ModelName Model reported by the provider, when known. Usage TokenUsage (prompt/completion/total), when the backend reports it. Duration Time spent in the provider call.

Expected failures (missing subtitles, HTTP errors, timeouts) come back as IsSuccess == false; exceptions are reserved for programming errors and cancellation.

docs.title: 5. Choose a provider at run time
docs.text:
ISummarizerPipelineFactory creates a pipeline for a provider id:

var factory = provider.GetRequiredService<ISummarizerPipelineFactory>();
var ollama = factory.Create("ollama");

Use it when the provider is selected dynamically (a UI dropdown, a batch job with mixed settings). Unknown ids fail inside RunAsync with a descriptive error.

docs.title: 6. Custom prompts
docs.text:
SummaryRequest accepts two optional fields:

new SummaryRequest(
    transcript,
    PromptStyle.Neutral,
    OutputFormat.Markdown,
    Instructions: "Five bullets, no fluff.",
    SystemPrompt: null); // set to replace the built prompt entirely

Instructions is appended to the style/format prompt. SystemPrompt, when set, wins and the style/format text is ignored. The same fields exist on SummarizeCommand, which is what the CLI uses.

LlmPrompts.BuildSystemPrompt(request) applies the rules; custom providers should call it instead of rebuilding the prompt.

docs.title: 7. Custom providers
docs.text:
Implement ILlmProvider, register it after AddBeesum, and point LlmProviderId/Create at its Id. Reuse the public prompt builder LlmPrompts.BuildSystemPrompt(style, format). See adding-a-provider.md for a full walkthrough.

Built-in implementations are internal; register and select them through DI.

docs.title: 8. Logging
docs.text:
Core services accept ILogger<T> and default to NullLogger. Register logging before building the provider:

services.AddLogging(builder => builder.AddConsole());

No transcript content, API keys, or cookies are logged.

docs.title: 9. Testing
docs.text:
var services = new ServiceCollection();
services.AddBeesum(options => options.OllamaBaseUrl = null);
services.AddBeesumTesting();

await using var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

AddBeesumTesting() replaces storage, yt-dlp, parser, process runner, and providers with in-memory doubles. Override a single double afterwards by registering it last:

services.AddSingleton<ILlmProvider>(new InMemoryLlmProvider("ollama"));

InMemoryProcessRunner records every invocation, so you can assert the exact argument list (the library always uses ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList).

docs.title: 10. Storage
docs.text:
The default root is %APPDATA%\Beesum on Windows and ~/.config/Beesum elsewhere. It contains settings.json, secrets.dat, transcripts/, and history.jsonl. At the moment the pipeline consumes only the ytdlp.path setting; the cache and history contracts exist for hosts to use.

DpapiSecretStore uses DPAPI on Windows; on other platforms it stores secrets in plain files in the same directory, so keep that path private.

docs.title: 11. Lifetime and threading
docs.text: All registered services are singletons and stateless per request: a single pipeline can process independent commands concurrently. SummaryResult is immutable; pass CancellationToken to stop work promptly.

docs.title: .NET tool
docs.text:
Requires the .NET 10 runtime.

dotnet tool install -g beesum-min
dotnet tool install -g beesum-mcp

docs.title: Library
docs.text:
dotnet add package Beesum.Core
dotnet add package Beesum.Testing   # test projects

docs.title: Docker
docs.text:
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/out" ghcr.io/air-catfish/beesum-min:latest \
  "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..." -o /out/summary.md

The image includes yt-dlp and deno.

docs.title: From source
docs.text:
dotnet build beesum-min.slnx -c Release
dotnet run --project src\Beesum.Min.Cli -- --local-vtt samples\demo\talk.vtt

yt-dlp must be in PATH, in tools/ next to the executable, or passed with --yt-dlp.

docs.title: Check the environment
docs.text:
beesum-min doctor
beesum-min doctor --check-updates

docs.title: MCP server
docs.text: beesum-mcp is a small Model Context Protocol server over stdio. It exposes the same pipeline as the CLI as two tools, so an agent can summarize a YouTube video or a transcript it already has.

docs.title: Install and configure
docs.text:
dotnet tool install -g beesum-mcp

Claude Desktop / Cursor / any MCP client:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "beesum-min": {
      "command": "beesum-mcp",
      "env": {
        "BEESUM_PROVIDER": "transcript-only",
        "BEESUM_PROXY": "socks5://127.0.0.1:1080"
      }
    }
  }
}

Remove BEESUM_PROXY unless you need one. BEESUM_PROVIDER defaults to transcript-only.

docs.title: summarize_url
docs.text: Argument Type Meaning url string, required YouTube URL. style historian | programmer | neutral Built-in prompt shortcut. format markdown | plaintext | mindmap Output format. instructions string Extra instructions appended to the prompt. timestamps boolean Prefix cues with [hh:mm:ss] and ask the model to keep them. prompt string Full system prompt; replaces style/format. provider string Provider id, overrides BEESUM_PROVIDER.

docs.title: summarize_transcript
docs.text:
Argument Type Meaning text string, required Plain text or WebVTT. input_format text | vtt Default text. style, format, instructions, prompt, provider, timestamps Same as above.

Tool results are a single text content block with the summary. Expected failures (isError: true) carry the pipeline's error message, so the agent does not need to parse stderr.

docs.title: Environment
docs.text:
Variable Default Purpose BEESUM_PROVIDER transcript-only Default provider id. BEESUM_OLLAMA_URL http://localhost:11434 Ollama base URL. BEESUM_OLLAMA_MODEL llama3.2 Ollama model. BEESUM_PROXY unset Passed to yt-dlp as --proxy. BEESUM_SUB_LANGS en Comma-separated subtitle languages. OPENAI_API_KEY unset Enables the OpenAI-compatible provider. BEESUM_OPENAI_URL / BEESUM_OPENAI_MODEL OpenAI / gpt-4o-mini Override endpoint. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset Enables Anthropic. GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY unset Enables Gemini.

API keys are read from the server environment only; they never appear in tool arguments or protocol messages.

docs.title: Protocol
docs.text:
• newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdio;
  • initialize, ping, shutdown, tools/list, tools/call;
  • supported protocol versions: 2024-11-05, 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18;
  • stdout carries protocol messages only; logs go to stderr;
  • no resources, prompts, sampling, or HTTP transport.

The server is meant for a local MCP client: one process, one user, one session.

docs.title: Try it by hand
docs.text:
printf '%s\n' \
  '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"shell","version":"1"}}}' \
  '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' \
  '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"summarize_transcript","arguments":{"text":"Hello world"}}}' \
  | beesum-mcp

docs.title: Security
docs.text: The canonical policy is SECURITY.md in the repository.

docs.title: Short version
docs.text:
• Local CLI; MCP is local stdio. Do not expose either to an untrusted network.
  • transcript-only never sends the transcript anywhere. Ollama stays local.
  • API keys come from env variables or the local secret store.
  • Windows uses DPAPI; Unix uses a 0600 file, not encryption yet.
  • yt-dlp runs as a child process with an argument list, not through a shell.
  • MCP summarize_url accepts YouTube hosts only.
  • Docker runs as UID/GID 10001; yt-dlp and deno are pinned and checksummed.
  • No telemetry, no background network activity.

docs.title: Known limitations
docs.text:
• Unix secrets are permission-protected, not encrypted.
  • NuGet packages are not signed; there is no SBOM yet.
  • No rate limit for a local caller.
  • Prompt-injected transcripts can make a summary misleading; no code execution.
  • The git tag is not signed.

docs.title: Report
docs.text: Use GitHub Security Advisories, or the Codeberg issue tracker if GitHub is not available. Do not open a public issue for an unfixed vulnerability.
